item.title: Bill Gates' daughters join mother to sign as founding backers of $100 million fund
item.description: Melinda French Gates, alongside her daughters, has joined a groundbreaking philanthropic venture designed to enhance women's health globally. The Women's Health Co-Lab aims to generate $100 million, supporting diverse organizations over three years. Phoebe Gates highlights the ongoing challenges women encounter in health and safety. With over $70 million already pledged by prominent philanthropists, the initiative is actively seeking more funding to meet its goal and broaden its reach.

item.title: Michigan woman’s survivorship deed upheld over daughter’s challenge
item.description: A Michigan appeals court has confirmed the validity of a survivorship deed that granted ownership of a house to Jessica Rae Harless. The ruling asserts that Shirley Ann Page's 2012 deed established a joint tenancy with rights of survivorship. Despite Anita Lanctot's challenge regarding the absence of the term 'joint' in the deed, the court affirmed that Page's intent was unmistakably conveyed, ensuring Harless retains sole ownership of the property.

item.title: Russia building 'security zone' in Ukraine that won't be part of future peace talks: Putin
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin announced the creation of a security zone within Ukraine to secure Russia's borders. He stated that his armed forces are successfully pushing Ukrainian troops beyond Russian territory. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov detailed that this buffer zone spans 660 km, with Russian control over 70 percent. The ongoing operation aims to ensure the necessary security for Russia, according to Peskov.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Aston Martin-designed Hudson Valley home on 55 acres lists for $19.5m
item.description: Selling for $19.5 million, David Ingram's architecturally magnificent Hudson Valley home, designed by Aston Martin, is now available. The residence includes broad living spaces and striking details, reflecting five years of enhancements since he bought it in 2020. Noteworthy features include a swimming pool and an underground automotive gallery. Now focused on his wellness endeavors, Ingram rarely visits, prompting this sale of his exquisite property.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Hawaii shark tours make visitors 40% more likely to support conservation: Study
item.description: Shark populations are declining significantly due to human activities and a third of species are threatened. Participation in shark ecotourism leads to increased conservation efforts among tourists and the public. After two years, those who engaged in ecotourism showed a 40% increase in conservation activities. Educational experiences during these tours provide vital information about the role of sharks in the ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Court tells US to process Green Card applications for up to 55k people
item.description: A federal judge has ordered the reopening of the diversity visa lottery for 2027, allowing 55,000 applicants. The ruling came after a lawsuit filed against Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding the lottery's registration. Judge Jinsook Ohta mandated a 30-day registration period for submissions, which must meet eligibility requirements. Additionally, new policy changes require some applicants to return to their home countries for Green Card processing.

item.title: Ryan Clark challenges Stephen A. Smith over Lane Johnson’s retirement
item.description: Ryan Clark defended Lane Johnson after Stephen A. Smith questioned the Eagles tackle’s retirement and mental health reasons. Clark said the impact of someone’s words matters more than their intentions. Johnson retired on October 6 after 14 seasons with Philadelphia, explaining that his mental health and family priorities had changed and he needed to step away from football.

item.title: Russian officer helped Ukraine kill over 300 troops by leaking military secrets: Report
item.description: Russian army lieutenant Lev Stupnikov took a perilous stand against his own military by secretly supplying Ukrainian forces with critical intelligence. His actions led to the targeted elimination of more than 300 Russian soldiers and deliberate sabotage of weapons systems, culminating in his flight to the Russian Volunteer Corps as a direct challenge to Putin's leadership. Stupnikov’s bravery reshaped the landscape of the ongoing Ukraine conflict.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: US temple plot, school shooting: Gun epidemic spares no one as debate goes off target
item.description: A neo-Nazi teen attempted a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Illinois, but his rifle jammed. The attack highlights ongoing debates about gun violence and societal issues, including parenting and mental health. Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi expressed horror that the attack targeted Indian Americans during worship. Many lawmakers condemned the incident, emphasizing the need to address religious and racial hatred in society.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Rs 10,000 crore for small businesses: Who can benefit from India's new SME Growth Fund?
item.description: The Union Cabinet has greenlit a substantial Rs 10,000-crore SME Growth Fund dedicated to bolstering small and medium enterprises. This initiative focuses on equity investments in growth-driven manufacturing businesses that demonstrate strong viability and scalability. While the fund's launch is promising, the specifics of how to apply are still under wraps, making its successful impact contingent on the effective expansion of the chosen enterprises.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Return of Gulf oil: Has Iran lost grip on Hormuz & what does it mean for India?
item.description: The US war with Iran exposed Tehran’s ability to disrupt the global economy by blocking the Strait of Hormuz. Before the war, around 19 million barrels of crude oil were exported daily from the Middle East. However, September data from tanker-tracking firm Kpler showed oil flows recovering to an average of 16 million barrels per day, the highest since the conflict began.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN

item.title: 6,000 cops, 2 notices, Dipke among 150 detained: How unrest unfolded in central Delhi
item.description: A protest march called 'Lehra Do Tiranga' saw widespread detentions by Delhi Police in Connaught Place. The event protested against the detention of Cockroach Janta Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Authorities restricted gatherings at Central Park due to a lack of official permission for the march. Parallel protests occurred near Mandi House, where demands for the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar arose.
item.dc:creator: VRITI JAIN

item.title: No Jadeja, Iyer to lead in last two ODIs: Check full Test and ODI squads vs NZ
item.description: The BCCI selection committee has announced India's ODI and Test squads for the upcoming tour of New Zealand. India will play five T20Is, five ODIs and two Tests on the tour. Fast bowlers Akash Deep and Anshul Kamboj have returned to the Test squad. Shubman Gill will lead India in the first three ODIs, while Shreyas Iyer will captain the team in the last two matches.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Two vessels carrying 24 Indian seafarers hit by projectiles, drone in separate incidents
item.description: Union shipping minister Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed that two vessels carrying Indian seafarers were attacked in October. The MT ST 3 was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, while the YARA J was hit by a drone off Romania. Fortunately, all 24 Indian nationals aboard both vessels are reported safe and unharmed. India has condemned attacks on commercial vessels, citing concerns for the safety of seafarers.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: From Ronaldo to Ronaldinho: How 10 football stars earned UAE Golden Visas
item.description: From Cristiano Ronaldo and Paul Pogba to Rio Ferdinand and Patrice Evra, several football legends have secured UAE Golden Visas and built connections with the region beyond the pitch. From business ventures and youth development to media careers and sports investments, explore how 10 footballers have used their long-term residency to expand their professional and personal ties with the Emirates.
item.dc:creator: SOROR SHAIZA

item.title: TGIKS 5: Kapil Sharma jokes Saif Ali Khan has kids in every decade
item.description: Kareena Kapoor and Saif Ali Khan graced 'The Great Indian Kapil Show' with their lively presence. They exchanged humorous stories about their lives, including Saif's numerous marriage proposals, which left the audience in stitches. Kareena humorously highlighted Saif's notorious snoring, prompting a series of light-hearted jabs between the two. They also shared their family aspirations, infusing joy and laughter into the show's atmosphere.

item.title: 'Got 9 people murdered': On cam, big claim by Nitish's MLA; then clarification
item.description: Recalling his sacrifices for Nitish Kumar, Anant Snigh claimed: “Who has made as many sacrifices as I have? Nitish Kumar was nothing back then. He used to roam around here and there. At that time, while being with Nitish Kumar, I got nine people murdered,” Singh said. However, later the leader clarified that his remarks was misinterpreted and that he was referring to the killing of nine of his associates.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Deepti, debutant Niki rescue India after top-order collapse against Zimbabwe
item.description: India had to work harder than expected while chasing a target of 115, but recovered from losing four wickets for just 19 runs to reach the target with 4.2 overs to spare.
item.dc:creator: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI

item.title: Curtains for Ravindra Jadeja in ODIs? All-rounder drops out of 2027 World Cup plans
item.description: Since the 2023 ODI World Cup, Ravindra Jadeja has featured in only 15 of the 32 ODIs India have played. In his last eight matches, he has picked up just three wickets at an economy rate of over six. Captain Shubman Gill has maintained that Jadeja was not dropped for the third ODI, but the 37-year-old is now fourth in the pecking order among India’s bowling all-rounders, behind Axar Patel, Washington Sundar and Harsh Dubey.
item.dc:creator: PRATYUSH RAJ

item.title: Why BCCI named two captains for India's New Zealand ODI series
item.description: India will have two captains during the five-match ODI series against New Zealand. Shubman Gill will lead the team in the first three matches, while Shreyas Iyer will take over for the final two games.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Oh(io) No: Vivek Ramaswamy's Catch-22 problem with MAGA
item.description: Ramaswamy is running to become Ohio governor, a position he perhaps sees as a stepping stone to something bigger in the party. Yet Ramaswamy’s association with Trump is increasingly becoming a liability among neutral voters, while his faith and skin colour are proving a deterrent among parts of the MAGA base.
item.dc:creator: NIRMALYA DUTTA

item.title: Zubeen Garg death case: Gauhati HC grants bail to suspended DSP Sandipon Garg
item.description: The Gauhati High Court has granted bail to Sandipon Garg, the suspended Assam Police DSP, linked to the controversial death of his cousin, Zubeen Garg. Arrested by the Special Investigation Team, Sandipon follows Amritprava Mahanta, the first accused, who also received bail. Additionally, the Supreme Court emphasized the need for an expedited trial for festival organizer Shyamkanu Mahanta amidst discussions on the nature of Zubeen's death—accidental or conspiratorial.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Zelenskyy slams Trump's diesel deal, says will help fund Putin’s war in Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed concerns over the US diesel deal with Russia. He warned that this agreement could provide additional funds for Russia's ongoing war against Ukraine. Zelenskyy emphasized the need for Europe to increase support to Ukraine as missile attacks continue. The president requested significant financial assistance to maintain Ukraine's defense against Russian aggression.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: SIR protests: Opposition has found common ground. But can it stay united?
item.description: Opposition parties in India are gradually uniting to support protests against the Chief Election Commissioner. Following arrests of CJP leaders, Rahul Gandhi showed solidarity, signaling a possible shift in strategy. Previously, Congress and CJP had organized separate protests over electoral issues, but they now seem to be collaborating more closely.
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE

item.title: Putin, Trump to announce several joint projects as Russian diesel returns to market
item.description: Russia and the United States are set to announce new initiatives beyond their recent diesel agreement. Discussions reportedly include collaborative data centre projects powered by Russian nuclear energy. Supplies of diesel have begun reaching international markets following the deal with the United States. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has criticized the arrangement, expressing concerns about its implications for energy revenue.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Shubman Gill returns to Ranji Trophy, set to play Punjab's next match
item.description: Shubman Gill is set to return to action for Punjab in the 2026-27 Ranji Trophy season. He will play in the second-round match against Chhattisgarh starting on October 18. Gill missed the opening match against Assam, which was led by Uday Saharan. Recently, Gill was honored as the ICC Men's Player of the Month for the fifth time.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Oprah Winfrey’s $12m gift still supports Smithsonian theatre 13 years later
item.description: With a remarkable contribution of $13 million, Oprah Winfrey has solidified her legacy at the National Museum of African American History and Culture. Her financial support was instrumental in the museum's fundraising efforts, culminating in the naming of the Oprah Winfrey Theater. This theater serves as a vital space for public events, fostering discussions surrounding African American history and cultural narratives.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: India flags trade concerns, market access barriers; China reacts
item.description: China has acknowledged India's concerns regarding trade barriers and the growing trade deficit during recent discussions. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted India's challenges in accessing the Chinese market for its products. The trade deficit with China widened significantly, reaching $105.93 billion in the first nine months of the year. India is striving to improve bilateral trade ties with China through negotiations and ongoing discussions.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: 'We'll knock it out fast': Trump may target Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility
item.description: Donald Trump indicated that the US may target Iran's Pickaxe Mountain facility to deter nuclear weapon development. He stated that nuclear weapons would not be necessary for achieving US objectives in the situation. The remarks followed ongoing US-Israeli strikes against Iran since February, amid rising tensions. Iran's foreign ministry denied any nuclear activity at the site, labeling US threats as baseless.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY
